note: The Molt reversal layer for all six Aviary Arcana trumps (the game-original trumps XXII–XXVII). Adds a 'reversed' + 'molt' block to each; uprightMeaning aliases each card's existing coreMeaning. The Molt (aviary_25) entry is reused verbatim from data/reversals-sample.json as the self-referential patron of the mechanic.
accentMoltRule: warm+inward/deficiency -> drained ash; any+shadow/renewal -> oil-slick iridescent; cool+blocked -> frost-dimmed

cards.uprightMeaning: The great journey, endurance, collective destiny, no turning back

reversed.meaning: The crossing stalled — strength spent mid-route, the flock scattered and lost from sight, 'no turning back' soured into trapped en route with no shore in reach.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode strands the journey: the long-payoff engine freezes its progress, holding course but unable to advance until something breaks the stall.

molt.featherState: flight feathers ragged and overworked, a few primaries shed and lagging in the slipstream
molt.lighting: cold underlight off a greying dusk instead of the warm horizon key
molt.borderState: the travel-patch filigree fraying loose, compass motif jammed
molt.moltGlyph: single shed flight feather in the cartouche

cards.uprightMeaning: Sanctuary, rest, belonging, the safe return, community shelter

reversed.meaning: The shelter that smothers — refuge curdled into a cage, belonging into dependence, the safe return into never being able to leave home.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode clings: the safe-harbor recall keeps allies home and bound — protected but unable to be deployed until they break free.

molt.featherState: breast feathers loosened and clumped, a few shed and caught in the tower mouth
molt.lighting: cold rim-light closing in, the colony-tower glow dimmed to a held shadow
molt.borderState: the sheltering-arc motif drawn tight and frayed, doorkeeper bands strained
molt.moltGlyph: single shed breast feather in the cartouche

cards.uprightMeaning: Upheaval, raw forces, riding chaos, harnessing what you cannot control

reversed.meaning: Thrown by the chaos instead of riding it — swept off the thermal, control lost, the raw forces now overwhelming rather than harnessed.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode loses the reins: the high-risk swing no longer converts disruption to power — board chaos batters its owner instead.

molt.featherState: wing coverts windbeaten and shedding, throat-pouch slack, feathers torn loose in the gust
molt.lighting: flat cold underlight off the storm wall, the lightning behind gone grey and distant
molt.borderState: the static-charm filigree shorted out and unravelling
molt.moltGlyph: single shed wing feather in the cartouche

cards.uprightMeaning: Transformation of self, shedding an old identity, renewal

reversed.meaning: Change refused — clinging to the old self, transformation forced or resisted, stuck between two coats.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Patron card: upright it lets you choose to Molt a unit; Molt-reversed it forces a unit to flip whether it wants to or not.
reversed.note: Self-referential anchor — this card is the in-world governor of every other card's Molt state.

molt.featherState: caught fully mid-shed, half scarlet half drab, a storm of loose feathers
molt.lighting: split light — warm key dying on one side, cold rim rising on the other
molt.borderState: the frame itself molting, motifs half-shed
molt.moltGlyph: two crossed shed feathers in the cartouche

cards.uprightMeaning: Unity, emergence, the many-as-one, collective will, strength in numbers

reversed.meaning: Unity soured into the mob — groupthink, the individual erased, the murmuration turned from one mind into a swarm of pressure that crushes dissent.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode swarms in excess: the go-wide power still scales with numbers but now bleeds its own units, the many consuming the one.

molt.featherState: the foreground bird's crest feathers shedding, the swarm behind ragged with drifting loose feathers
molt.lighting: cold underlight, the dawn behind gone bruised; the murmuration darkened to a pressing mass
molt.borderState: the squad-band filigree fraying, signal-tags tangling
molt.moltGlyph: single shed crest feather in the cartouche

cards.uprightMeaning: Liminality, hidden truth, omen, the threshold between states

reversed.meaning: The threshold won't open — omens ignored, truth kept hidden, caught and dimmed between two states with no crossing and no answer.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode seals the door: the peek/freeze effect turns inward — information stays hidden even from its owner, the board locked a beat too long.

molt.featherState: camouflage feathers loosened and scruffy, a few shed against the bark, the bird stiller still
molt.lighting: cold uplight instead of the corona key; the ringed eclipse behind gone dull and ashen
molt.borderState: the ringed-eclipse motif frayed, the still-watch bands slack
molt.moltGlyph: single shed cryptic feather in the cartouche
